JIRA_ACTIVE_AMBIGUOUS: More than one active sprint was found on the board.
JIRA_BOARD_NOT_SCRUM: The configured board is not a Scrum board.
JIRA_CARD_APPEND_MISMATCH: Blocks appended to the Jira card did not read back as written.
Check the page; retried next run.
JIRA_CARD_CONFIG_INVALID: The Jira card configuration is not valid.
JIRA_CARD_CONFIG_MISSING: The Jira card configuration is missing.
JIRA_CARD_GTV_NOT_OWNED: The Global Talent Visa callout block is not the visa callout, so nothing is changed.
JIRA_CARD_GTV_NO_LINE: The Global Talent Visa callout holds no single `GTV Action` line to fill, so nothing is written.
Put one `GTV Action` line in the callout.
JIRA_CARD_GTV_VERIFY_FAILED: The Global Talent Visa line did not read back as written.
JIRA_CARD_NOT_OWNED: The Jira card block is not one V7 owns, so nothing is changed.
None; the card never edits what it does not own.
JIRA_CARD_NO_SNAPSHOT: No Jira snapshot is stored yet for the card.
None; the snapshot stage runs first.
JIRA_CARD_STALE_NO_BASELINE: The snapshot is stale and V7 has not written this card yet, so there is nothing known-good to keep showing.
JIRA_CARD_TOO_MANY_BLOCKS: The rendered card has more blocks than Notion accepts in one call.
JIRA_CARD_VERIFY_FAILED: The Jira card did not read back as written.
JIRA_CARRY_VERIFY_FAILED: Carried issues did not show in the new sprint yet; Jira reads can lag. Nothing was closed.
JIRA_CATCHUP_FAILED: The catch-up rollover step could not be verified.
JIRA_CLOSE_VERIFY_FAILED: The old sprint did not show as closed.
JIRA_EARLY_ROLLOVER: The rollover was asked before the sprint's end.
JIRA_ERROR: An unnamed Jira error; the board position is appended.
JIRA_FILL_FAILED: The parent, Component or Fix Version fill could not write any ticket it found (a Jira write failed).
JIRA_FINAL_VERIFY_FAILED: The rollover's final check did not match.
JIRA_MEJ_BACKLOG_FAILED: The Jira backlog placement or its read-back failed (permission, rate limit, timeout or an unreadable reply); the sprint was not closed.
None until the backlog contract is verified (LIFE-918); nothing was changed beyond the verified carry.
JIRA_MEJ_BACKLOG_PARTIAL: Not every excluded MEJ issue was found in the backlog after the move; the sprint was not closed.
One bounded re-plan, then it stops; inspect the sprint before the next run.
JIRA_MEJ_BACKLOG_UNVERIFIED: Unapproved unfinished MEJ work lacks a verified backlog destination before sprint close.
Verify the Jira Agile backlog REST operation and readback, then explicitly replan without blanket carry.
JIRA_MEJ_DESTINATION_MISMATCH: A carried issue and a backlogged issue ended up in the wrong destination (a child apart from its parent).
Do not close; inspect the source sprint, the target sprint and the backlog.
JIRA_MEJ_FINITE_NOT_CARRY: A finite weekly occurrence is selected for automatic sprint carry.
Remove this occurrence from the approved next-sprint roster; preserve its truthful status.
JIRA_MEJ_INVENTORY_INVALID: The unfinished sprint inventory is incomplete, ambiguous or lacks required issue type.
Refresh Jira source inventory; no sprint was closed.
JIRA_MEJ_ROSTER_INVALID: The MEJ carry roster does not exactly identify approved standard deliverables in the unfinished source sprint.
Obtain Matt's exact written roster and compare the frozen sprint inventory.
JIRA_MEJ_SPRINT_STALE: The source sprint read is stale (already closed) or an issue reads as belonging to another sprint.
Refresh the Jira sprint inventory; no sprint was closed.
JIRA_NOT_MONDAY: The rollover only runs on Mondays.
JIRA_NO_END_DATE: The active sprint has no end date.
JIRA_NO_ROLLOVER_CANDIDATE: There is no sprint to roll over.
JIRA_PARENT_NOT_AN_EPIC: The named parent of a new LIFE ticket is not an epic.
Name an epic as the parent and create it again.
JIRA_PARENT_REQUIRED: A new LIFE ticket was created without a parent epic.
Name the parent epic and create it again.
JIRA_RECONCILE_CLOCK_INVALID: The reconciliation clock carried no time zone.
JIRA_RECONCILE_DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE: A recurring series has more than one occurrence in the next week's sprint; nothing is created or changed for it.
JIRA_RECONCILE_FAILED: The daily sprint reconciliation failed on one or more boards; the board position and codes follow.
Open the jira job's reconcile step.
JIRA_RECONCILE_IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS: A recurring series has two origins or a loop in its clone links, so it is not synchronized.
JIRA_RECONCILE_SPRINT_CONFLICT: A sprint is not one Monday-to-Sunday week, two sprints share a week, or a future sprint is off the weekly grid, so the board's sprints are left unchanged.
Fix or close the odd sprint.
JIRA_RECONCILE_TRANSITION_AMBIGUOUS: An issue has no single Done transition, so the automatic close was not made.
Check the workflow of the project; retried next run.
JIRA_RECONCILE_VERIFY_FAILED: After the sprint inventory writes, a re-read still showed work to do.
None; the next run plans from actual state.
JIRA_RECONCILE_WRITER_UNVERIFIED: A live daily reconciliation has no verified Jira writer or checkpoint, so it refuses to run.
None until LIFE-918 verifies the tenant writes.
JIRA_RELEASE_FAILED: The auto-release rule could not move any ticket it found ready (a Jira write failed).
JIRA_ROLLOVER_UNKNOWN_TYPE: The ending sprint holds an unfinished issue of a type the carry rule does not know.
Move or retype that issue; retried next run.
JIRA_START_VERIFY_FAILED: The new sprint did not show as active.
JIRA_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS: More than one future sprint could be the target.
JIRA_TARGET_NOT_FUTURE: The target sprint is not a future sprint.
JIRA_TARGET_NOT_STAGED: The next two-week sprint is missing from the approved roadmap.
Plan the next sprint in Jira before enabling rollover.
JIRA_UNSUPPORTED_CADENCE: The sprint dates do not define a Monday-Sunday 7- or 14-day window.
Correct the sprint dates in Jira.
JIRA_VERIFY_ARGUMENTS_INVALID: The writers verification was given a board that is not configured or a malformed issue key.
Fix the board name or the issue key.
JIRA_VERIFY_CONTRACT_FAILED: The read-only contract check failed, so the throwaway verification wrote nothing.
Run the contract check and read which check failed.
JM_DASH_JIRA_BAD_PAGE: Jira's search answered in an unexpected shape.
JM_DASH_JIRA_TOO_MANY_PAGES: A Jira search (the Hermes request stage) matched more issues than one run reads.
